metric_guide.label: Average Deficit Score

metric_guide.label: Weighted Deficit Score

metric_guide.label: Logic Density Ratio (LDR)

metric_guide.label: Inflation-to-Code Ratio (ICR)
metric_guide.means: Unjustified jargon compared with average cyclomatic complexity.

metric_guide.label: Dependency Usage Ratio (DDC)
metric_guide.means: Imported libraries that are referenced by runtime code.
